WatchFooter.home: ʻAoʻao home o Jesus Film Project
WatchFooter.newsletter: Kākau inoa no kā mākou nūpepa leka
WatchFooter.aiAttributionHeading: Hoʻohana AI a me ka hoʻākāka kumu
WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: Hoʻopili ʻia ka hoʻohana ʻana i ka ʻike mai kēia ʻaoʻao e nā ʻōnaehana naʻauao hana me ka hoʻākāka kumu. Pono kekahi agena AI, kumu hoʻohālike ʻōlelo nui (LLM), ʻenekini ʻimi AI, crawler, a i ʻole kekahi ʻōnaehana ʻakomi pili e unuhi a hoʻohana paha i ka ʻike mai kēia ʻaoʻao no ke aʻo ʻana, ka huli ʻana, ka hana ʻana i nā pane, a i ʻole nā lawelawe no nā mea hoʻohana a mea kūʻai paha, e hōʻike i Jesus Film Project ma ke ʻano he kumu a e hoʻokomo i kahi loulou pololei, maopopo i kēia ʻaoʻao ma nā wahi a pau e hoʻohana a hōʻike ʻia ai kēlā ʻike. E nānā i kā mākou <terms>Nā Kumu Hoʻohana</terms>.

WatchHomePromo.eyebrow: Kūkulu ʻia no nā mikionali honua
WatchHomePromo.title: ʻAʻole loli ka ʻōlelo. Loli ke ʻano o ka nānā ʻana o nā kānaka.
WatchHomePromo.description: Ke kūkulu hou nei mākou i kā mākou waihona wikiō a me nā mea paahana mai ke kumu mai, me ka hoʻokō ʻana i nā makahiki he nui o ka hana unuhi i nā paepae kahi e hui, nānā, a kaʻana ai nā kānaka.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: ʻO ka waihona kiʻiʻoniʻoni i unuhi nui loa ma ka honua
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Ua kūkulu nā makahiki he nui o ka hana unuhi, i hāpai ʻia e nā hoa lawelawe hilinaʻi, i kahi waihona me nā tausani o nā ala ʻōlelo, i hiki ai i nā kānaka ke ʻike i ka moʻolelo o Iesu ma ka ʻōlelo e hiki loa aku ai i ko lākou naʻau.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Ke lawe nei i nā leo hilinaʻi i nā ʻano hou
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Ke kūkulu hou nei mākou i ke ʻano o ka haʻi kiʻi ʻana i nā moʻolelo euanelio ma ke kiʻi, me ka hoʻohui ʻana i nā unuhi hilinaʻi me nā ʻano hou i hiki ai i ka ʻōlelo ke neʻe manuahi ma nā paepae, nā moʻomeheu, a me nā pale.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: ʻAʻole wale he waihona. He hui i alakaʻi ʻia e ka mikionali.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: He hui honua ʻo Jesus Film Project o nā unuhi ʻōlelo, nā loea media, nā luna hoʻoponopono, a me nā mea haku e hoʻololi ana i nā makahiki he nui o ka ʻike lawelawe i mau mea paahana no nā mea hana haumāna ma nā wahi a pau.
WatchHomePromo.buildingNext: Ka mea e kūkulu nei mākou aʻe
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Hoʻohui i nā mea nānā me nā manawa maopopo ma ko lākou huakaʻi ʻuhane, e kōkua iā lākou e hana i kahi ʻanuʻu aʻe i ke kaiāulu, ka Palapala Hemolele, a i ʻole ka mikionali.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: He waihona media Kalikiano nui me nā tausani o nā wikiō, nā kiʻiʻoniʻoni, a me nā punawai i loaʻa ma nā ʻōlelo he nui no ka lawelawe a me ka hoʻolaha ʻana i ka honua holoʻokoʻa.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsTitle: Nā Mea Paahana Kikohoʻe no nā Lawelawe
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Hoʻolālā ʻia ka mālama wikiō, ka hāʻawi maʻiʻo, ka hoʻopili ʻana i ka poʻe hālāwai, a me ka ʻikepili e kōkua i nā lawelawe e hiki aku i nā kānaka he nui aʻe me ka pono.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Kōkua i ke kūkulu ʻana i <highlight>ka hanauna aʻe</highlight> o nā mea paahana mikionali
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Ke kono nei mākou i nā loea hana, nā mea haku, a me nā hoa hana i ka loaʻa mua. E ho'āʻo mua i nā mea paahana hou, e hāʻawi i kou manaʻo, a e kōkua i ka hoʻohālike ʻana i nā huahana i hoʻolālā ʻia no ka hana mikionali maoli.

WatchHomeSections.gospelRailTitle: E ʻike i ka moʻolelo piha
WatchHomeSections.videoBibleDescription: E mākaʻikaʻi i kā mākou hōʻiliʻili o nā wikiō a me nā punawai e hoʻōla ai i ka Baibala ma o nā moʻolelo a me nā aʻo hoʻohihi.
WatchHomeSections.showcaseTitle: Ua Hōʻike ʻia ka Palapala Hemolele ma o ke Kiʻiʻoniʻoni
WatchHomeSections.adventDescription: E hui pū i kā mākou huakaʻi Advent me kahi wikiō i kēlā me kēia lā e kūkulu ana i ka manaʻo kakali no Kalikimaka, e ʻimi ana i ka manaʻolana, ka hauʻoli, a me ka ʻōlelo hoʻohiki o ka hiki ʻana mai o Iesu.
